text.tspan: You can find them on top of the bunkers on each side of the map.
Be sure to check the movement controls to see how enter and exit the helicopter.
In terms of helicopter movement, you use the same keys as the player movement.
The helicopters are ridable, you can enter a flying helicopter by touching it, and pressing
your "Crawl / Dive" button (space). And you can exit with the "Exit" button (Q).
When you drive the helicopter, you can shoot rockets, with 45 RPM.
If you ride a helicopter, you can use your inventory as you want.
Keep in mind that you cannot damage the helicopter you ride.
When the helicopter crashes or gets shot down, you will die if you are driving it, and take
heavy damage if you are riding it.
If you drive the helicopter and want to exit it, you need to land it before pressing exit.
Due to cloud limitations, your helicopter will be deleted if you exit it and you are the driver.
You will always be visible on the minimap if you drive a helicopter.
